answer: In an agent marketplace trading velvet, jetty berths, and quill pens, each seller must lock $100 in escrow for 30 days before its offers become visible. The same deposit cannot back multiple identities, and creating a new identity requires a fresh deposit. A sybil attacker running 10,000 sellers must therefore immobilize $1 million for a month, paying financing costs even if none of the fake sellers makes a sale.
